infilling.def: Building new homes or businesses on vacant or underused lots inside an area that is already built up, instead of on open land at the edge.

residential-density.def: The number of housing units or people on a given area of land; apartments give high density, detached houses on large lots give low density.

zoning.def: Local laws that divide a city into zones and set what may be built in each, such as homes, stores or factories, and how tall or dense.
